endow.en: The alumni agreed to endow a scholarship for first-generation students.
endow.zh: 校友們同意捐贈一筆獎學金，資助第一代大學生。

bestow.en: The mayor will bestow an honorary medal on the volunteer firefighters.
bestow.zh: 市長將授予義務消防隊員榮譽獎章。

grant.en: The board voted to grant the researchers full access to the archive.
grant.zh: 董事會投票同意授予研究人員完整檔案查閱權。

donate.en: Many neighbors donate winter coats to the shelter every December.
donate.zh: 許多鄰居每年十二月都會把冬衣捐贈給收容所。

bequeath.en: In her will she chose to bequeath the piano to her youngest niece.
bequeath.zh: 她在遺囑裡決定把鋼琴遺贈給最小的姪女。

despoil.en: Invaders threatened to despoil the temple of its ancient treasures.
despoil.zh: 侵略者揚言要掠奪神廟裡的古代珍寶。

bereave.en: The sudden illness bereaved the village of its only doctor overnight.
bereave.zh: 突如其來的疾病一夜之間剝奪了村莊唯一的醫生。

disenfranchise.en: New ID rules could disenfranchise elderly voters who lack recent photos.
disenfranchise.zh: 新的身分證明規定可能剝奪沒有近期照片的年長選民的投票權。

strip.en: The storm stripped the paint from the wooden fence in a single night.
strip.zh: 暴風雨一夜之間就把木柵欄上的油漆剝去了。

confiscate.en: Customs officers confiscate undeclared cash at the airport border.
confiscate.zh: 海關人員在機場邊境沒收未申報的現金。

gift.en: She wrapped a small gift for her tutor before the final class.
gift.zh: 期末課前，她為導師包了一份小禮物。

basket.en: He carried a wicker basket filled with fresh pears from the orchard.
basket.zh: 他提著一個裝滿果園新鮮梨子的柳條筐。

ballot.en: Each citizen marked a secret ballot and dropped it into the box.
ballot.zh: 每位公民在祕密選票上作記號，再投入票箱。

will.en: His will left the lakeside cabin to his sister and her children.
will.zh: 他的遺囑把湖邊小屋留給妹妹和她的孩子們。

pocket.en: She slipped the spare key deep into her coat pocket before leaving.
pocket.zh: 出門前，她把備用鑰匙深深塞進大衣口袋。

key.en: Without the brass key, nobody could open the locked classroom cabinet.
key.zh: 沒有那把銅鑰匙，誰也打不開上鎖的教室櫃。

guard.en: A night guard walked the museum halls with a flashlight and radio.
guard.zh: 夜班警衛提著手電筒和對講機巡視博物館走廊。

dissemble.en: Please do not dissemble about the conflicting interests in this deal.
dissemble.zh: 請不要掩蓋這筆交易中互相衝突的利益關係。

frank.en: Her frank comments about the draft helped the team fix weak paragraphs.
frank.zh: 她對初稿坦率的意見幫助組員修正薄弱段落。

artless.en: His artless smile made the nervous visitors feel welcome at once.
artless.zh: 他淳樸自然的笑容立刻讓緊張的訪客感到受歡迎。

aboveboard.en: Their negotiations stayed aboveboard, with every fee listed in writing.
aboveboard.zh: 他們的談判始終光明正大，每筆費用都以書面列出。

duplicitous.en: The editor called the spokeswoman's story duplicitous and self-serving.
duplicitous.zh: 編輯批評發言人的說法既欺騙又自私自利。

underhanded.en: Rivals used underhanded leaks to damage the campaign before the debate.
underhanded.zh: 對手用狡詐的洩密手段，在辯論前打擊競選活動。

sly.en: A sly grin crossed his face when he spotted the hidden camera.
sly.zh: 他發現隱藏攝影機時，臉上閃過一絲狡猾的笑。

truthserum.en: In the skit, only truthserum could make the stubborn witness confess.
truthserum.zh: 短劇裡，只有吐實藥才能讓頑固證人坦白。

smokebomb.en: The thief tossed a smokebomb and vanished into the crowded market.
smokebomb.zh: 小偷丟出煙霧彈，隨即消失在擁擠的市集裡。

handshake.en: A firm handshake sealed the partnership before either side signed.
handshake.zh: 雙方簽名前，一次有力的握手就敲定了合作關係。

pokerface.en: She kept a perfect pokerface while the dealer revealed the last card.
pokerface.zh: 莊家翻出最後一張牌時，她仍維持完美的撲克臉。

opensource.en: His opensource attitude meant he shared notes without hiding tricks.
opensource.zh: 他開源分享的態度意味著筆記公開、不藏招數。

trapdoor.en: The stage crew opened a trapdoor so the actor could disappear mid-scene.
trapdoor.zh: 舞台人員打開暗門，讓演員在戲中途消失。

fib.en: He told a harmless fib about finishing the chores to avoid a lecture.
fib.zh: 為了躲訓話，他撒了個無害的小謊說家事做完了。

maskoff.en: After the recording leaked, the politician's maskoff moment shocked fans.
maskoff.zh: 錄音外流後，政客摘下面具的一刻讓粉絲震驚。

spotlight2.en: Under spotlight2, every contradiction in her story became obvious.
spotlight2.zh: 在聚光燈檢視下，她說法中的每個矛盾都變得明顯。

receipt2.en: Keep receipt2 from the store so you can prove the refund amount.
receipt2.zh: 保留店家收據，才能證明退款金額。

lie.en: One small lie about the deadline snowballed into a larger cover story.
lie.zh: 關於截止日期的一個小謊言，滾成了更大的掩飾說法。

vow.en: They exchanged a quiet vow to finish the project before winter break.
vow.zh: 他們安靜地立下誓言，要在寒假前完成專案。

whisper2.en: A soft whisper2 passed along the back row during the quiet exam.
whisper2.zh: 安靜考試時，後排傳來一陣輕聲低語。

camera.en: A hallway camera recorded who entered the lab after midnight.
camera.zh: 走廊鏡頭監視並記錄誰在午夜後進入實驗室。

alibi.en: His solid alibi placed him on a train when the window was broken.
alibi.zh: 他有力的不在場證明顯示窗戶被砸時他在火車上。

seal.en: Officials placed a red seal across the door of the sealed evidence room.
seal.zh: 官員在封存證物室的門上貼上紅色封條。

glassbox.en: The rare manuscript sat inside a glassbox under soft museum lights.
glassbox.zh: 稀有手稿放在博物館柔光下的玻璃箱裡。

humility.en: True humility showed when she credited her teammates for the award.
humility.zh: 她把獎項歸功於隊友時，真正的謙遜顯現出來。

meek.en: The meek intern rarely interrupted, yet her written notes were sharp.
meek.zh: 溫順的實習生很少插話，但書面筆記卻很敏銳。

demure.en: In a demure gray dress, she greeted guests with a soft, careful smile.
demure.zh: 她穿著端莊的灰色洋裝，用溫柔謹慎的笑容迎接賓客。

unassuming.en: The unassuming chef never bragged, though critics praised every dish.
unassuming.zh: 這位謙遜的主廚從不誇耀，儘管評論家讚美每道菜。

unpretentious.en: Their unpretentious cafe served simple soup without fancy menu language.
unpretentious.zh: 那間不做作的咖啡館供應簡單湯品，菜單也不裝腔作勢。

modest.en: He gave a modest answer and refused to exaggerate his contribution.
modest.zh: 他給出謙遜的回答，拒絕誇大自己的貢獻。

understated.en: Her understated jacket looked elegant without any flashy logos.
understated.zh: 她那件低調外套優雅大方，沒有任何炫目標誌。

coy.en: With a coy glance, she delayed answering the personal question.
coy.zh: 她用害羞扭捏的一瞥，拖延回答那個私人問題。

haughty.en: His haughty tone made the clerks feel they were being talked down to.
haughty.zh: 他高傲的語氣讓職員覺得自己被看低。

hubris.en: Corporate hubris ignored early warnings and led to a costly collapse.
hubris.zh: 企業的自大忽視早期警告，最後導致代價高昂的崩潰。

pompous.en: The pompous speech dragged on with empty phrases and no clear plan.
pompous.zh: 那場誇耀浮誇的演說充滿空話，卻沒有清楚計畫。

pretentious.en: The pretentious review used big words to hide a thin argument.
pretentious.zh: 那篇矯飾誇耀的評論用大詞掩蓋薄弱論點。

ostentatious.en: An ostentatious gold watch flashed each time he raised his hand.
ostentatious.zh: 他每次舉手，那只炫耀用的金錶就閃一下。

overbearing.en: An overbearing manager interrupted every idea before it was finished.
overbearing.zh: 專橫傲慢的主管還沒聽完就打斷每個想法。

grandiose.en: His grandiose plan promised a tower but lacked any realistic budget.
grandiose.zh: 他浮誇的計畫承諾蓋塔，卻完全沒有務實預算。

bombast.en: The speech was pure bombast—loud claims with almost no evidence.
bombast.zh: 那場演說盡是吹噓空話——聲量大、證據幾乎沒有。

effrontery.en: It took real effrontery to demand a raise after missing every deadline.
effrontery.zh: 每次期限都錯過還敢要求加薪，簡直厚顏無恥。

showy.en: The showy parade float glittered, but the music was barely rehearsed.
showy.zh: 炫耀顯眼的花車閃閃發光，但音樂幾乎沒排練。

bluster.en: His angry bluster filled the hallway, yet he offered no workable fix.
bluster.zh: 他狂妄咆哮的怒吼充滿走廊，卻提不出可行解法。

prig.en: Nobody liked the office prig who scolded others for tiny mistakes.
prig.zh: 沒人喜歡那個自認清高、為小事訓人的同事。

overweening.en: Overweening pride made him dismiss advice from far more experienced staff.
overweening.zh: 過度自負讓他拒絕經驗更豐富同仁的建議。

sententious.en: His sententious lectures on virtue bored classmates who wanted practical tips.
sententious.zh: 他好說教的美德講課，讓想聽實用技巧的同學感到無聊。

orotund.en: An orotund voice rolled through the hall, more theatrical than sincere.
orotund.zh: 做作洪亮的聲音貫穿大廳，戲劇感多於真誠。

abase.en: He refused to abase himself with a false apology just to keep the job.
abase.zh: 他拒絕為保職位而用假道歉貶低自己。

supplicate.en: Refugees had to supplicate for food and water at the crowded border gate.
supplicate.zh: 難民必須在擁擠的邊境關口懇求食物與飲水。

embrace.en: The school decided to embrace bilingual teaching across every grade.
embrace.zh: 學校決定擁抱接納雙語教學，並推廣到每個年級。

encompass.en: The new course will encompass literature, history, and basic rhetoric.
encompass.zh: 新課程將涵蓋文學、歷史與基礎修辭。

incorporate.en: Please incorporate these photos into the same case file as the letters.
incorporate.zh: 請把這些照片合入與信件同一份案件檔案。

include.en: The packing list should include snacks, water, and a spare map.
include.zh: 打包清單應包括零食、飲水與備用地圖。

admit.en: Guards will admit only ticket holders after the lobby doors close.
admit.zh: 大廳門關閉後，保全只准許持票者進入。

shun.en: After the scandal, former allies began to shun her at public events.
shun.zh: 醜聞之後，昔日盟友開始在公開場合躲避她。

bar.en: Security rules bar visitors from bringing glass bottles into the stadium.
bar.zh: 保全規定禁止訪客把玻璃瓶帶進球場。

banish.en: The council voted to banish the corrupt official from public office.
banish.zh: 議會投票把腐敗官員放逐出公職。

omit.en: Writers should omit filler sentences that add length but no meaning.
omit.zh: 寫作者應省略只拉長篇幅卻無意義的廢話句子。

rope.en: They tied a thick rope around the crates so nothing would slide free.
rope.zh: 他們用粗繩綁住木箱，免得東西滑脫。

barrier.en: Police set up a wooden barrier to keep the crowd off the wet street.
barrier.zh: 警方架起木製拒馬，不讓人群走上濕滑街道。

guestlist.en: Check the guestlist twice before printing name cards for the banquet.
guestlist.zh: 宴會名牌印刷前，請把賓客名單核對兩次。

bouncer.en: The club bouncer checked IDs and turned away anyone under eighteen.
bouncer.zh: 夜店保全核對身分證，並拒絕未滿十八歲者進入。

stamp.en: The clerk pressed a blue stamp on each approved application form.
stamp.zh: 職員在每份核准申請表上蓋上藍色戳章。

fence.en: A wooden fence separated the playground from the busy parking lot.
fence.zh: 一道木圍籬把遊樂場與繁忙停車場隔開。

welcome.en: A warm welcome waited for the exchange students at the dorm lobby.
welcome.zh: 宿舍大廳為交換學生準備了溫暖的歡迎。

acumen.en: Her business acumen helped the startup survive its first tough year.
acumen.zh: 她的商業敏銳與洞察力幫助新創熬過艱難的第一年。

acuity.en: Mental acuity matters when you must spot errors in dense legal text.
acuity.zh: 要在密實法律文本中抓錯，心思敏銳至關重要。

adroit.en: His adroit replies to hecklers won him supporters in the crowded hall.
adroit.zh: 他對搗亂者敏捷靈巧的回覆，在擁擠大廳贏得支持者。

astute.en: An astute tenant always reads the small print before signing a lease.
astute.zh: 精明的房客簽約前一定會讀細則小字。

shrewd.en: She made a shrewd trade that protected the firm from a sudden loss.
shrewd.zh: 她做了一筆精明交易，讓公司免於突然虧損。

asinine.en: Skipping the safety drill was an asinine choice that risked everyone.
asinine.zh: 跳過安全演練是愚蠢的選擇，讓所有人陷入風險。

crass.en: His crass joke about the accident silenced the entire dinner table.
crass.zh: 他對意外開的粗俗愚鈍玩笑，讓整桌晚餐陷入沉默。

obtuse.en: He seemed deliberately obtuse when asked who had changed the numbers.
obtuse.zh: 被問到是誰改了數字時，他顯得刻意愚鈍。

dense.en: The professor's dense explanation left half the class still confused.
dense.zh: 教授難以理解的說明，讓半數同學仍然困惑。

dull.en: After a sleepless night, his dull answers showed he was barely awake.
dull.zh: 一夜未睡後，他遲鈍的回答顯示幾乎醒不過來。

fatuous.en: A fatuous claim that grades do not matter annoyed serious students.
fatuous.zh: 說成績無關緊要的愚笨說法，惹惱了認真的學生。

inept.en: His inept handling of the press conference created needless panic.
inept.zh: 他不適當地處理記者會，造成不必要的恐慌。

mallet.en: The carpenter tapped the peg gently with a wooden mallet.
mallet.zh: 木匠用木槌輕輕敲打木栓。

lens.en: She cleaned the camera lens before photographing the garden flowers.
lens.zh: 拍攝花園花朵前，她先擦拭相機鏡頭。

focus.en: Turn the ring slowly until the text comes into sharp focus.
focus.zh: 慢慢轉動對焦環，直到文字清晰對焦。

wit.en: Quick wit saved the speaker when the projector suddenly failed.
wit.zh: 投影機突然故障時，機智救了演講者一命。

fogbrain.en: After three all-nighters, fogbrain made him forget simple passwords.
fogbrain.zh: 連續三晚熬夜後，霧腦讓他連簡單密碼都忘了。

edge.en: The knife's sharp edge sliced the apple into clean, even wedges.
edge.zh: 刀刃鋒利，把蘋果切成整齊均勻的瓣。

bluntedge.en: A bluntedge knife smashed the tomato instead of cutting it cleanly.
bluntedge.zh: 鈍刃刀子把番茄壓爛，無法乾淨切開。

disinterested.en: We need a disinterested judge with no stake in either company's deal.
disinterested.zh: 我們需要公正無私、與兩家公司交易都無關的法官。

impartial.en: An impartial referee treats both teams by the same written rules.
impartial.zh: 不偏不倚的裁判依同一書面規則對待兩隊。

aloof.en: She stayed aloof at the party, watching quietly from the far corner.
aloof.zh: 派對上她保持高冷超然，安靜地待在遠角觀望。

clinical.en: His clinical tone described the accident without emotional coloring.
clinical.zh: 他冷靜客觀的語氣描述意外，不帶情緒色彩。

egalitarian.en: Their egalitarian policy gave every intern the same training budget.
egalitarian.zh: 他們的平等政策讓每位實習生享有相同培訓預算。

bigot.en: A loud bigot refused to listen to any view that challenged his own.
bigot.zh: 一個固執的偏執者拒絕聽任何挑戰己見的觀點。

demagogue.en: The demagogue stirred anger with slogans instead of workable plans.
demagogue.zh: 蠱惑民心的政客用口號煽動怒火，卻不提可行計畫。

partisan.en: Partisan coverage praised one candidate and ignored the other's record.
partisan.zh: 有偏見的黨派報導讚美一方，卻忽略另一方的紀錄。

tendentious.en: The tendentious article selected only facts that supported one side.
tendentious.zh: 那篇有傾向性的文章只挑選支持單一方的事實。

skew.en: Missing data can skew survey results toward wealthier neighborhoods.
skew.zh: 資料缺失會使調查結果歪斜偏向較富裕社區。

jaundice.en: Old rivalry left him with a jaundice toward every rival proposal.
jaundice.zh: 舊日競爭讓他對對手的每個提案都懷有偏見。

preconception.en: A stubborn preconception about rural schools blocked useful reforms.
preconception.zh: 對鄉村學校根深蒂固的偏見阻擋了有用的改革。

slanted.en: The slanted headline made a minor delay sound like a national crisis.
slanted.zh: 有偏向的標題把輕微延誤說成全國危機。

biased.en: A biased sample of only city voters cannot represent the whole state.
biased.zh: 只抽城市選民的有偏樣本，無法代表全州。

partial.en: Teachers must not be partial to students who sit in the front row.
partial.zh: 老師不應偏袒坐在前排的學生。

evenhanded.en: An evenhanded coach praised effort on both winning and losing teams.
evenhanded.zh: 公平的教練對勝負兩隊的努力都給予肯定。

detached.en: She stayed detached during the quarrel so she could mediate fairly.
detached.zh: 爭吵時她保持超然，才能公平調解。

liquidate.en: Creditors moved to liquidate the failing shop and sell its inventory.
liquidate.zh: 債權人著手清算倒閉商店並變賣庫存。

enamel.en: The artisan layered bright enamel over the copper plate before firing.
enamel.zh: 工匠在銅板上鋪上明亮瓷釉，再送進爐中燒製。

extenuate.en: Returning the wallet did not extenuate the fact that he had stolen it.
extenuate.zh: 歸還皮夾並不能減輕他曾偷竊的罪過。

antiquated.en: Antiquated farming tools slowed the harvest compared with modern machines.
antiquated.zh: 過時的農具讓收成速度慢於現代機械。

hoary.en: The hoary oak had stood beside the church for more than two centuries.
hoary.zh: 那棵極老的橡樹已在教堂旁屹立兩百多年。

archaic.en: Students giggled at the archaic pronouns in the nineteenth-century letter.
archaic.zh: 學生們對十九世紀信件裡古老的代名詞咯咯笑。

obsolete.en: Floppy disks are obsolete, and most laptops cannot read them at all.
obsolete.zh: 軟碟已遭淘汰，多數筆電根本讀不了。

dated.en: The dated slang in the textbook made teenagers roll their eyes.
dated.zh: 課本裡過時的俚語讓青少年翻白眼。

musty.en: A musty smell rose from the cardboard boxes stored in the attic.
musty.zh: 閣樓紙箱散出一股霉舊氣味。

modish.en: Her modish scarf matched the latest catalog, though it cost a fortune.
modish.zh: 她時髦的圍巾跟上最新目錄，不過貴得要命。

trendy.en: The trendy cafe changed its menu every month to chase online fame.
trendy.zh: 那間流行咖啡館每月改菜單，以追逐網路聲量。

stylish.en: A stylish raincoat turned rainy mornings into a small fashion show.
stylish.zh: 一件有風格的雨衣，把下雨早晨變成小型時尚秀。

fresh.en: The bakery put out fresh bread still warm from the early morning oven.
fresh.zh: 麵包店端出清晨出爐、還熱呼呼的新鮮麵包。

cuttingedge.en: Their cuttingedge lab equipment attracted researchers from three countries.
cuttingedge.zh: 他們尖端的實驗室設備吸引了三國的研究人員。

up-to-date.en: Keep the handbook up-to-date whenever the safety rules change.
up-to-date.zh: 安全規則一變更，就要把手冊更新到最新。

popup.en: A weekend popup shop sold handmade soaps near the subway exit.
popup.zh: 週末快閃店在捷運出口附近販售手工肥皂。

tourguide.en: Our tourguide explained the murals before we entered the quiet chapel.
tourguide.zh: 導遊在我們進入安靜小教堂前解說了壁畫。

price-tag.en: She checked the price-tag twice before putting the coat back on the rack.
price-tag.zh: 她把外套放回架上前，把價籤看了兩次。

mothball.en: Grandma tucked a mothball into each wool sweater before packing them.
mothball.zh: 奶奶把每件羊毛衣收進箱前都塞一顆樟腦丸。

unbox.en: Viewers watched him unbox the new phone and test every camera mode.
unbox.zh: 觀眾看他開箱新手機並測試每種相機模式。

vintage.en: She wore a vintage jacket from the seventies to the school reunion.
vintage.zh: 她穿著一件七〇年代的復古外套去同學會。

hashtag.en: Add a clear hashtag so classmates can find photos from the field trip.
hashtag.zh: 加上清楚標籤，方便同學找到校外教學照片。

dust.en: Sunlight showed a thin layer of dust on the unused classroom shelves.
dust.zh: 陽光顯出閒置教室書架上的一層薄灰塵。

methodical.en: Her methodical checklist kept the science fair booth calm and on time.
methodical.zh: 她有條理的核對清單，讓科展攤位保持冷靜準時。

systematic.en: A systematic review of the data revealed the same error in every week.
systematic.zh: 系統性檢視資料後，發現每週都有同一個錯誤。

disciplined.en: Disciplined practice each morning improved his piano speed and accuracy.
disciplined.zh: 每天早上有紀律的練習，提升了他鋼琴的速度與準度。

tidy.en: Please keep your desk tidy so the next class can find shared supplies.
tidy.zh: 請保持桌面整齊，好讓下一班找到共用文具。

ratiocination.en: Careful ratiocination led her from clues to the only possible culprit.
ratiocination.zh: 仔細推理讓她從線索推到唯一可能的兇手。

havoc.en: The storm wreaked havoc on power lines across the coastal towns.
havoc.zh: 暴風雨對沿海城鎮的電線造成大混亂與破壞。

turmoil.en: Political turmoil delayed the opening of the new public library.
turmoil.zh: 政治騷動延遲了新公共圖書館的開幕。

tumult.en: A sudden tumult in the square forced shops to pull down their shutters.
tumult.zh: 廣場突如其來的混亂暴動，迫使店家拉下鐵門。

welter.en: She sorted through a welter of receipts before filing the tax forms.
welter.zh: 報稅前，她先整理一堆混亂雜亂的收據。

ruckus.en: A hallway ruckus over lost headphones interrupted the quiet study hour.
ruckus.zh: 走廊因耳機遺失引發的騷亂喧鬧，打斷了安靜自習時間。

muddle.en: Mixed instructions can muddle beginners who need one clear sequence.
muddle.zh: 混亂的指示會使需要單一清楚步驟的初學者更糊塗。

snarl.en: An accident created a traffic snarl that stretched for three blocks.
snarl.zh: 一起車禍造成長達三個街區的交通混亂堵塞。

riotous.en: Riotous cheering filled the gym after the last-second winning shot.
riotous.zh: 最後一秒決勝球進後，體育館充滿暴亂般的喧鬧歡呼。

discombobulated.en: The sudden schedule change left him discombobulated and missing books.
discombobulated.zh: 突然改課表讓他混亂困惑，還把書忘了帶。

addle.en: Too many alarms can addle a tired student during morning study time.
addle.zh: 鬧鐘太多會在晨讀時把疲倦學生弄得糊塗混亂。

flustered.en: She grew flustered when the microphone cut out mid-sentence.
flustered.zh: 麥克風講到一半斷掉時，她變得慌張混亂。

unkempt.en: His unkempt hair and wrinkled shirt suggested he had overslept again.
unkempt.zh: 凌亂的頭髮與皺襯衫，顯示他又睡過頭了。

uproar.en: The canceled concert caused an uproar among fans waiting at the gate.
uproar.zh: 演唱會取消在門口等候的粉絲間引發喧鬧騷動。

free-for-all.en: Without clear rules, the debate turned into a noisy free-for-all.
free-for-all.zh: 沒有清楚規則，辯論變成一場嘈雜混亂的混戰。

scruffy.en: The scruffy suitcase had broken zippers and stains from long travel.
scruffy.zh: 那只骯髒破舊的行李箱拉鍊壞了，還有長途旅行的污漬。

huddle.en: Players huddle near the bench to whisper the next defensive play.
huddle.zh: 球員在板凳旁擠成一團，低聲密商下一波防守。

rout.en: The visiting team suffered a rout and lost by more than thirty points.
rout.zh: 客隊慘遭潰敗，輸了超過三十分。

spontaneous.en: A spontaneous song broke out when the power returned to the subway.
spontaneous.zh: 捷運恢復供電時，自然而然地爆發出一首自發的歌。

trek.en: The long trek through muddy hills left everyone's boots soaked.
trek.zh: 穿越泥濘山丘的艱苦跋涉，讓大家的靴子全濕透。

tussle.en: A brief tussle over the last umbrella ended with shared laughter.
tussle.zh: 為最後一把傘扭打爭執片刻後，雙方笑著和解。

surreptitious.en: A surreptitious glance at the answer key is still cheating in class.
surreptitious.zh: 上課偷偷摸摸瞄一眼答案卡，仍算作弊。

manifest.en: Her relief became manifest when the final grades finally appeared online.
manifest.zh: 期末成績終於上網時，她的寬慰清楚展現出來。

ardent.en: Ardent fans waited outside the theater despite the cold evening rain.
ardent.zh: 熱心熱情的粉絲不顧傍晚冷雨，仍在戲院外等候。

ardor.en: Youthful ardor for the cause kept volunteers working past midnight.
ardor.zh: 對這項事業的年輕狂熱，讓志工工作到午夜之後。

fervid.en: Fervid applause followed the choir's final high note in the chapel.
fervid.zh: 合唱團在小教堂唱出最後高音後，爆發狂熱掌聲。

zealous.en: A zealous volunteer arrived early to set up every folding chair.
zealous.zh: 熱情的志工提早到場，把每張折疊椅都排好。

impassioned.en: Her impassioned speech about clean rivers moved the whole town meeting.
impassioned.zh: 她充滿激情的愛河演說感動了整場鎮民大會。

ebullient.en: Ebullient performers bounced onstage and waved to every section of seats.
ebullient.zh: 熱情奔放的表演者跳上舞台，向每個座位區揮手。

apathetic.en: Apathetic voters skipped the local election and later regretted it.
apathetic.zh: 冷漠的選民略過地方選舉，後來才感到後悔。

stolid.en: The stolid watchman barely blinked when the siren finally stopped.
stolid.zh: 警報終於停時，冷漠遲鈍的守衛幾乎眨都不眨。

lukewarm.en: The committee gave lukewarm support and delayed any real funding.
lukewarm.zh: 委員會只給不冷不熱的支持，並拖延真正的資金。

halfhearted.en: A halfhearted apology without changed behavior convinced nobody.
halfhearted.zh: 沒有改變行為的不認真道歉，說服不了任何人。

thermometer.en: The nurse checked the thermometer twice before recording the fever.
thermometer.zh: 護理師把溫度計查看兩次後才記錄發燒數值。

lava.en: Hot lava from the volcano cooled into black rock along the shore.
lava.zh: 火山熔岩沿著海岸冷卻成黑色岩石。

icecube.en: She dropped one icecube into the tea and watched it melt slowly.
icecube.zh: 她把一顆冰塊丟進茶裡，看它慢慢融化。

shrug.en: With a small shrug, he admitted he had forgotten the meeting time.
shrug.zh: 他輕輕聳肩，承認自己忘了開會時間。

volcano.en: Scientists warned that the volcano might erupt again within days.
volcano.zh: 科學家警告這座火山可能在數日內再度爆發。

freezer.en: Put the leftover soup in the freezer before it spoils overnight.
freezer.zh: 把剩湯放進冷凍庫，免得隔夜壞掉。

spark.en: A tiny spark from the fireplace landed safely on the stone hearth.
spark.zh: 壁爐迸出的一點火花安全落在石砌爐台上。

frost.en: Morning frost covered the grass and made the path slippery to walk.
frost.zh: 清晨的霜覆蓋草地，讓小路走起來很滑。

fever.en: A sudden fever kept her home from school for the rest of the week.
fever.zh: 突如其來的發燒讓她整週其餘日子都無法上學。

chill.en: An evening chill settled over the park after the sun dropped low.
chill.zh: 太陽西沉後，一陣涼快的晚風籠罩公園。

commend.en: Teachers commend students who cite sources carefully in every essay.
commend.zh: 老師讚揚每篇作文都仔細引註來源的學生。

applaud.en: The audience rose to applaud the pianist after the final quiet chord.
applaud.zh: 最後一個安靜和弦結束後，觀眾起立鼓掌讚許鋼琴家。

panegyric.en: His panegyric for the retiring principal listed decades of quiet service.
panegyric.zh: 他為退休校長寫的頌詞，列出數十年默默服務。

encomium.en: Save a sincere encomium for after the project survives real testing.
encomium.zh: 等專案通過真正測試後，再獻上真誠的讚美。

condemn.en: Civic groups condemn violence and call for calm talks instead.
condemn.zh: 公民團體譴責暴力，並呼籲改以冷靜對話。

reprove.en: Coaches reprove players who skip warm-ups and risk needless injuries.
reprove.zh: 教練責備跳過熱身、徒增受傷風險的球員。

lambaste.en: Reviewers lambaste the film for lazy writing and cardboard characters.
lambaste.zh: 影評嚴厲批評這部片寫作懶散、角色扁平。
